title: Test Mind Map — the behaviour graph of one domain
$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the shape of `.claude/knowledge/domain/<file>.mind-map.json`. `npm run models:check` (scripts/maintenance/check-test-models.mjs) loads THIS file through ajv — it holds no second copy of these rules. Cross-file rules (edge endpoints, data references, case stamps, oracle ids, stable ids) are the checker's, because a schema cannot see other files. The map answers 'how can this domain behave?' and is NOT an oracle: an expected outcome cites BL-*/ECL-*/kb/doc through `oracle_refs`/`evidence`, never the map itself. Method: .claude/skills/qa-test-mind-map/SKILL.md. Linked tests are DERIVED from `Behavior:` stamps in suite References — deliberately not a field here, so the case↔behaviour link has exactly one writer.

domain_slug.$comment: Must equal the `domain_slug` of an existing domain map — the checker resolves it. Every node id starts with `<domain_slug>.`.

domain_map_rev.$comment: The domain-map `rev` this graph was derived from. Behind the map's current rev ⇒ a staleness warning.

id.$comment: Dotted, stable, NEVER renamed. A removed behaviour becomes status OBSOLETE; the id stays.

class.$comment: The provenance-tag vocabulary of .claude/skills/qa-test-cases-generator/test-case-template.md — no fourth vocabulary. DOC covers docs AND source code.

ref.$comment: A ticket key, a BL-/ECL- id, `kb:<KB-id>`, a VirtoOZ page, `repo-file:line`, a GraphQL op label, a run id or a case id.

chain_link.$comment: The `#` of the domain map §1 value-chain row this node realises, e.g. `2b`.

terminal.$comment: State nodes only: no transition may leave a terminal state.

technique.$comment: A §0 token of .claude/skills/qa-test-design/test-design-techniques.md — the checker validates it against that table at run time.

oracle_refs.$comment: Promoted oracle entries only. A PROPOSED- invariant is evidence (class SPEC/HYPOTHESIS), not an oracle.

maturity.$comment: CLAUDE.md §Product context: released vs new decides the source. A released CONFIRMED node needs DOC, BL or OBSERVED evidence; a new one may rest on SPEC.

status.$comment: The domain-map verdict vocabulary plus OBSOLETE. No numeric confidence: the checker derives consistency from the evidence classes.

expected.$comment: What the higher-precedence source says, with its ref.

observed.$comment: What the platform was seen to do, with its ref.

route.$comment: Who resolves the conflict, as something trackable: a tracker key of this deployment (JIRA_PROJECT_KEY), an issue/PR in a named repo or its URL, /qa-review-oracles, or a kb dispute. A route marked UNFILED, or naming none of these, is TM-018 (warn).

type.$comment: Node-to-node relations only. requires/produces point into the data model and live on the node; covers is derived from Behavior: stamps; implements is evidence.

via.$comment: transitions_to only: the behaviour node that performs the transition.
